kind: Historical source observations and proposed witnesses; not installed acceptance

source_binding.binding_provenance: Existing retained inventory records exact tree match; this reconciliation does not independently recertify source or installed behavior.

scope: User-approved solo-local features; one human may run multiple agents. Overlapping observation groups are not task counts, signoff gates or a completion denominator.
record_owner: Current claims, findings, implementation changes and acceptance results stay in live Trial193 and existing child/memory records. Revalidate current source before implementation.
preserved_boundaries: Actual denials; no retry through helpers, transports or permission changes
B7 storage binding before implementation acceptance/resume exposure
One independent reviewer and original findings/spent passes
Required exact-candidate CI, safe merge door and own-main CI
Protected unrelated work and actual native identity/claims/budgets

groups.name: Solo persona, configuration and workflow authoring
tier_conditions: Available to solo-developer; no team-binding or multi-tenant-compliance persona required.
features: Solo persona is runtime default; four workload classes; TOML/YAML versioned manifests; typed/unknown-field validation; environment/file/CLI configuration precedence; path bindings; workflow/default and per-step configuration; explicit optional-feature switches.
proposed_checks: Load one valid solo manifest and configuration, demonstrate one override, and refuse one malformed manifest without dispatch.

groups.name: Public CLI, MCP and Python execution ingress
tier_conditions: Available to solo-developer; no team-binding or multi-tenant-compliance persona required.
features: CLI run with provider/model/config/output options; one-shot bootstrap-execute-shutdown; daemon client over Unix socket; MCP run_workflow by registry key or manifest path; Python run; text/JSON results and typed exit statuses.
proposed_checks: Run a simple manifest through one-shot and daemon/MCP ingress and compare identity/status/JSON output.
limitations: Only run_workflow is registered as a public workflow MCP tool in this source; separate operator HTTP interface is outside selected local scope.

groups.name: Local process/session lifecycle and administration
tier_conditions: Available to solo-developer; no team-binding or multi-tenant-compliance persona required.
features: Persistent daemon socket/pidfile; bootstrap rollback; signal-driven drain; reject new work after drain; bounded shutdown and observability flush; per-process Python run concurrency guard; daemon request contexts.
proposed_checks: Start daemon, run work, invoke shutdown or SIGINT, and observe drain status and owned socket/process cleanup.
limitations: Daemon/session ownership is implemented; arbitrary interactive terminal attachment or frontend turn hooks are not established by this inventory.

groups.name: Six solo-usable multi-agent workflow patterns
tier_conditions: Available to solo-developer; no team-binding or multi-tenant-compliance persona required.
features: Single-threaded-linear; parallelization; orchestrator-workers; decentralized-handoff; hierarchical-delegation; evaluator-optimizer; workload/topology admissibility; branch-index ordered aggregation; cascade pause/proceed/cancel; evaluator structured verdict and iteration cap.
proposed_checks: Execute the six shipped local topology examples and inspect branch/evaluator outcomes, including an iteration-cap result that is completed but not accepted.
limitations: Orchestrator workers are declared steps[1:]; orchestrator output does not dynamically choose or reach workers. YAML topology fixtures are not runnable workflows. Source/tests exist; no live example result is claimed.

groups.name: Nested agents, briefs, roles and bounded concurrency
tier_conditions: Available to solo-developer; no team-binding or multi-tenant-compliance persona required.
features: Child workflow manifests/steps; canonical brief and summary hash; parent/child causality; inherited gate/placement constraints; role-specific model binding; recursive hierarchy; three-child hierarchical width cap; configurable sub-agent worker capacity; child failure/pause/refusal propagation.
proposed_checks: Run a root-middle-leaf workflow and observe canonical brief, distinct child identities, inherited constraints and returned/refused outcomes; refuse excess width.
limitations: Managed-agents is a separate implemented step kind for vendor-managed sessions, excluded by the selected local/subscription profile rather than by solo persona.

groups.name: Inter-step context and post-join synthesis
tier_conditions: Available to solo-developer; no team-binding or multi-tenant-compliance persona required. Inter-step context is opt-in; synthesis is a declared terminal step.
features: Linear/handoff prior-output delivery; evaluator draft/feedback delivery; per-run context isolation; effect-free post-join LLM synthesis over ordered worker outputs; deterministic fold without synthesis.
proposed_checks: Use identifiable upstream content to demonstrate downstream input and ordered synthesis; reject a synthesis tool binding.
limitations: Do not infer orchestrator-output-driven worker generation or orchestrator-to-worker context from synthesis support.

groups.name: Structured results, output replay and inspection
tier_conditions: Available to solo-developer; no team-binding or multi-tenant-compliance persona required. Output replay and protected-result options require their configured inputs.
features: Completed/failed/drained/partial/paused outcomes; terminal state and typed failure; pause reference; audit head and trace IDs; provider/model, dispatch-kind and provider-discriminator cost rollups; per-run persisted engine outputs; replay and fanout recovery markers; read-only human/JSON ledger inspection; pause/protected-result inspection.
Inspector trace-browser TUI and holdout sample/review/scaffold commands; audit verification and sidecar-migration administration where their explicit inputs are supplied.
proposed_checks: Inspect one successful and one refused/failed run, retrieve the actual output/reference, and verify replay preserves completed work rather than silently rerunning effects.
limitations: Text CLI intentionally summarizes status/workflow/ledger rather than printing the model reply; inspect cost evidence without claiming subscription quota or savings.
Inspector collector-store span ingestion is separately deferred; trace browser availability does not prove automatic collector population.

groups.name: Model/engine routing and resilience controls
tier_conditions: Available to solo-developer; no team-binding or multi-tenant-compliance persona required. Enabled providers, routing activation and optional offline embedding must be configured.
features: Workload/persona/deployment engine selection; five engine classes; layered routing; per-role/per-step provider/model/prompt binding; fallback chains; retry/backoff and circuit breakers; typed deadlines; post-effect no-retry fence; local/subscription routes.
proposed_checks: Observe configured role/step routing and one typed unavailable-provider or deadline outcome, with no excluded fallback and no second dispatch after a tool effect.
limitations: Detailed provider bindings, offline model assets and adapter security are assigned to the provider/deployment/security inventory. API and managed-provider source existence does not include those routes in the local release.

groups.name: Versioned prompts, role selection and cache controls
tier_conditions: Available to solo-developer; no team-binding or multi-tenant-compliance persona required. Binding-tier prompt-approval gate is inert for solo; prompt/cache options are explicit.
features: Inline and stored prompt versions; role/workload selection; per-step prompt override; reject unauthored hashes; provider cache directives, long-TTL workload controls, boot prewarm, daemon keepalive and concurrent cache cohorts.
proposed_checks: Use two role/step prompts and observe the selected content/version; reject a nonexistent version; inspect configured cache request metadata without inferring savings.
limitations: Provider-dependent cache behavior requires that provider; configuration does not establish a cache hit.

groups.name: Skill registry and activation hooks
tier_conditions: Available to solo-developer; no team-binding or multi-tenant-compliance persona required. Automatic selection requires an operator-supplied SkillActivationHook.
features: Load *.skill.json manifests; validate frontmatter; reject duplicate IDs; content version hash/body-token estimate; workflow-init and dispatch selection hooks; explicit activate_skill; activation spans.
proposed_checks: Load one valid skill, reject a duplicate or invalid manifest, and observe the selected skill activation evidence.
limitations: Current Skill stores manifest and source_path; body_tokens may use description as a proxy. Examined hook emits spans and does not deliver a skill body into prompts. Skill-declared tool registration is explicitly deferred; do not promise full SKILL.md discovery/content delivery.

groups.name: Tool contracts, MCP clients and deferred discovery
tier_conditions: Available to solo-developer; no team-binding or multi-tenant-compliance persona required. MCP servers and allowed contracts require explicit configuration.
features: Named ToolContract registration; duplicate/reserved-name rejection; MCP stdio/StreamableHTTP/SSE clients; tool discovery and calls; frozen schema superset; deferred search_tools; per-call trust and schema checks; idempotency, timeouts and result normalization.
proposed_checks: Discover and call one configured local MCP tool, reject an unregistered/malformed call, and discover a deferred tool without changing the frozen schema.
limitations: Detailed sandbox, secret and network enforcement is assigned to the security/deployment inventory.

groups.name: Model-emitted tools and operator assessment
tier_conditions: Available to solo-developer; no team-binding or multi-tenant-compliance persona required. Tool-capable enabled provider and offered tools required.
features: Offered-membership/schema validation; bounded model/tool iterations; tool rewrite/assessment before dispatch; DENY/HOLD/refusal; operator disposition auditing; post-effect terminal fence; tool result returned to inference.
proposed_checks: Observe one real local model tool call and its result, then a denied/unoffered call with zero tool effect and an attributable outcome.
limitations: examples/README.md says Ollama has no MCP tool loop, but llm_dispatch.py implements _dispatch_ollama_with_hitl_tool_loop; documentation is stale. Detailed memory-tool semantics belong to the memory inventory.

groups.name: Solo approval, response palettes and notifications
tier_conditions: Available to solo-developer; no team-binding or multi-tenant-compliance persona required. Read-only persona floor auto defaults on; local-mutation auto requires opt-in; external effects retain ASK/DENY floors.
features: AUTO/ASK/DENY composition; placement inheritance; response approve/edit/reject/respond/hold where permitted; cross-trust/validator palette narrowing; MCP elicitation; timeout fail-closed; operator-policy override with append-only evidence; optional webhook delivery.
proposed_checks: Use an elicitation-capable client to answer one gate and observe permitted edit/approval or rejection, with inherited restrictions preserved.
limitations: Python api.run explicitly declines elicitation; CLI daemon ClientSession does not bind an elicitation callback. Their existence is not a complete interactive answer surface.

groups.name: Pause-state access, durable resume and recovery
tier_conditions: Available to solo-developer; no team-binding or multi-tenant-compliance persona required. Pause/resume requires opt-in; durable handles require durable storage; storage acceptance/exposure remains separately bound.
features: Python read_paused_workflow_state and resume; durable pause handles and claim admission; run identity/context preservation; corruption/staleness/workflow/child-handle refusal; root/child authority; nested/fanout pause context; engine-specific recovery and effect-fence resolution; journal inspect/adopt/dispose administration.
proposed_checks: Pause a workflow, inspect its actual durable state, resume via the owned handle and reject a second or stale resume without effects.
limitations: At this HEAD no CLI pause/answer/resume commands and no MCP pause/answer/resume tools are registered. A public live-pause request operation is not exported; internal pause_requested_flag exists. Operator-surface work remains real missing implementation, not a completed feature.

groups.name: Validation and escalation extension framework
tier_conditions: Available to solo-developer; no team-binding or multi-tenant-compliance persona required. Validator framework is explicit opt-in; default disabled.
features: CP validator registry/evaluate API; driver validation hooks; transient retry/escalation; narrowed HITL palette; cost/audit integration; optional webhook composer.
proposed_checks: With an explicitly supplied validator, demonstrate accepted/rejected result or escalation; otherwise report the runtime empty registry truthfully.
limitations: Runtime factory always builds validator_registry={}; RuntimeConfig marker carries no validators. End-user validator catalog/config/discovery is deferred; opt-in alone does not perform substantive validation.

groups.name: Canonical local persistence, five-tier typed envelopes, derived index and operation ledger
tier_conditions: runtime.memory.enabled; verified permitted state root; working tier is live context, not a claim that every tier is a persistent database
proposed_checks: Create permitted record, restart local runtime, read same ID/hash; rebuild missing/stale index without losing canonical records.
Concurrent bounded writers preserve guarded state and append-only ledger; restore smoke preserves record and ledger refs after B7 binding.
limitations: Source contains store/ledger locking and rebuild machinery; no persistence/restore run performed here. B7 retained-storage acceptance/exposure is still held without actual binding.

groups.name: Automatic episodic capture and explicit event capture
tier_conditions: capture_run_events/capture_turns and capture policy; scope/provenance derived from actual dispatch
proposed_checks: One local workflow creates run/turn records plus CAPTURE rows with route/scope/source refs; resume does not rewrite old run-start scope.
Capture-disabled policy writes no new records; a torn run-start capture gets only its missing ledger row.
limitations: Automatic turn capture explicitly supplies promotion_candidates=(); capture alone does not generate reviewed reusable knowledge. Broader run-close/tool/failure/compaction capture APIs are not all demonstrated as automatically invoked.

groups.name: Policy-filtered query/retrieve/read, lexical ranking and bounded context packet
tier_conditions: active eligible record kind; requested scope and policy; token_budget; semantic/procedural data already admitted
proposed_checks: Query allowed fact/preference/decision/convention/failure-learning/research/procedural records; deterministic selected refs, exclusions, ranking trace and token-bounded packet.
Keep proposed/denied/expired/redacted/tombstoned/out-of-scope records out while preserving allowed positive control.
limitations: Current ranking is lexical token overlap plus confidence/authority/pinning/scope weights, not embedding vector memory recall. A per-dispatch MemoryPacket is implemented; no separate public session_packet operation was found in bounded harness-*/src scan.

groups.name: Prompt injection, native/provider access selection and subscription CLI delivery
tier_conditions: standard tools when supported/enabled, otherwise permitted prompt packet, then opt-in native provider, else no-access; subscription CLI has text transport
proposed_checks: Default-enabled memory delivers one allowed marker to both configured local Codex/Claude subscription workflow routes, with packet/ref/INJECT receipts.
NEVER and RETRIEVAL_ONLY semantic and procedural markers do not reach prompts; PROMPT_PACKET_ALLOWED does; malformed policy fails closed.
limitations: Current MemoryRetriever does not inspect content.injection_policy at all, although promotion writes it: jpp is a present source gap. CLI capability fix is present; do not call 2rk source-unimplemented based on old ticket. Automatic ownership/capture of arbitrary interactive frontend turns is a separate unresolved oxw integration boundary, not proven by workflow subprocess dispatch.

groups.name: Standard memory tools and optional native/backing stores
tier_conditions: tool-capable SDK route and standard_tool_access; native provider disabled by default; configured backend capability/auth remains required
proposed_checks: Exercise memory.search/read/write_note/propose_promotion/request_redaction through usable tool route, preserving scope/policy refs and durable write-like operation refs.
For local selected filesystem/SQLite backend, write/read after restart; optional encrypted/S3/managed backend checks only if that backend is selected and admitted.
limitations: Contracts expose five tools, not general memory import/export/approve CLI commands. Generic subscription CLI transport cannot call these tools; packet delivery is its supported current path. Tool promotion has the concrete M6 bugs. Remote provider/native memory is opt-in, not a prerequisite for local default.

groups.name: Reviewed semantic/procedural promotion, preferences, edits, deny and supersession
tier_conditions: retain actual review policy, source refs, target kind and explicit injection policy; proposed remains nonactive until permitted approval; do not impersonate human approver
proposed_checks: Capture prior work; propose semantic and procedural candidates; inspect source-linked PROPOSED state excluded from injection; apply actual approved decision, then later separate workflow reuses allowed knowledge.
Matrix PROMOTE_SEMANTIC/PROMOTE_PROCEDURAL against semantic/procedural targets: mismatches never autoactivate; forbidden/discard remain denied.
Procedural proposal/approval returns valid operation_ref matching its candidate/snapshot identity without post-write KeyError.
limitations: Current tool helper permits either promote decision without inspecting target_kind; extractor helper is target-aware. Current operation_ref indexes record.content[candidate_id], while procedural content uses snapshot_id. These match old oxw diagnostics; no reproducer/tests were run now. Automatic capture has no candidate extraction/usable CLI review flow wired; this is an operational gap, not permission to remove deliberate review.

groups.name: Scope, provenance, write/review policies and immutable audit identity
tier_conditions: solo workspace/workflow/provider-family/profile boundaries still apply; multiagent sharing only when permitted; multiuser certification outside current finish line
proposed_checks: Wrong workspace/family/profile denied without losing explicitly allowed multiagent recall.
Review-required or cross-family/unknown-provenance candidates cannot autoactivate; explicit actual approval remains distinguishable and source-linked.
limitations: Per-record injection restrictions are not enforced by current retrieval despite broad doc policy claims. Source refs may legally lack content_hash; traceability alone is not paraphrase accuracy proof. No actual-memory approval/export is authorized by this inventory.

groups.name: Content redaction, tombstone and retention expiry
tier_conditions: explicit redaction/retention operation; preserve ledger sidecars and exclusion from recall/tool reads
proposed_checks: Redact/tombstone/expire synthetic allowed record: durable transition precedes replacement/index exclusion, no former text in subsequent read or prompt; audit event remains.
Distinguish request_redaction tool receipt from actual applied redaction.
limitations: Policy declares retain/expire/prune/tombstone but this read does not establish an automatic expiry/pruning daemon. Secret/unrelated-file protections remain solo acceptance requirements.

groups.name: Migration, CLI source-import policy, compaction disposition and durability carriers
tier_conditions: explicit callback migration apply; CLI import policy; admitted compaction dispositions; selected engine durability evidence
proposed_checks: Callback migration dry-run reads without writes; explicit migrate writes canonical record and MIGRATE ledger event.
Before compaction, every candidate has reviewed/promoted/deferred/rejected disposition with durable COMPACTION_DECISION; restart preserves policy and refs.
If invoking profile import, deny-by-default external memory source policy is honored without mutating external source.
limitations: Bounded production-source scan found resolve_cli_profile and validate_memory_durability definitions only, and no CompactionSafetyHook instantiation; automatic path uses DEFAULT_GENERIC_CLI_PROFILE. General operator memory import/export and separate session-packet commands were not established in runtime CLI. tools/memory_compact.py manages Claude MEMORY.md index bytes, not this harness substrate: excluded. Do not import separate Omarchy/archive promises.

groups.name: Local L2 embeddings and cross-axis procedural context composition
tier_conditions: routing activation configured with admitted corpus, optional embedding extra, pinned local model/cache; procedural resolver from actual prompt/skill/routing state
proposed_checks: Selected local L2 routing loads verified pinned model offline and resolves admitted provider:model or falls through according to routing contract.
Changing active prompt/skills/prompt-selection/routing state changes procedural snapshot hash consumed by cross-axis ledger producers.
limitations: L2 embedding classifier chooses model route; MemoryRetriever uses lexical ranking. Do not advertise embedding-based memory semantic search without another implementation. Stage6 CxA wiring is an actual runtime composition owner; harness-cxa package itself mainly exposes audit conversion.

groups.name: Local package/config/run/daemon/operator UX
groups.baseline_status: Source entrypoints harness run/daemon/inspect/shutdown; YAML/TOML manifests, provider/model overrides, text/JSON results, UDS daemon-client and bounded drain/error outcomes implemented. Packaging/runtime origins need installation proof.
tier_conditions: solo-developer with local-development or self-hosted-server; choose actual config surface separately
proposed_checks: Build locked wheels and verify installed entrypoint/import origins; run one local workflow both one-shot and through existing UDS daemon, inspect state, then graceful shutdown.

groups.name: Local Ollama and configurable routing/reliability
groups.baseline_status: Ollama host/ping, optional-provider degradation, provider capabilities, manifest role/workload bindings and fallback policy wired. Availability and model assets not proven by source.
tier_conditions: No team-persona requirement; local Ollama models explicitly enabled; paid Anthropic/OpenAI SDK routes outside selected release profile
proposed_checks: With hosted providers disabled, send a discriminating local prompt; verify chosen provider/model, unavailable-model failure/fallback and no paid API route.

groups.name: Subscription CLI providers and instruction/memory profiles
groups.baseline_status: Typed Claude/Codex/Antigravity/Gemini/generic subprocess adapters, auth handling, private cwd, environment controls, bounded process cleanup, output parsing and profile provenance implemented. Native CLI login/service success remains external.
tier_conditions: Claude Code and Codex selected for first release. Antigravity/Gemini and generic-command adapters exist but are not implicit release additions; docs explicitly exclude Gemini/Antigravity overlays.
proposed_checks: Using existing subscription login, run one Claude and one Codex workflow; verify correct model/output, private-workspace isolation and auth refusal without credential/log leakage.

groups.name: Offline embedding and workload classifier
groups.baseline_status: Local hashes/layout/cache verifier and local_files_only FastEmbed binding exist. Guide explicitly says final ARM extra/model/no-network/live-discrimination proof unwitnessed; source example has two candidate labels while historical discrimination witness needs at least three.
tier_conditions: Optional embedding extra, routing_activation=true, verified local BAAI/bge-small-en-v1.5 assets/cache; no cloud classifier required
proposed_checks: On final ARM artifact with pre-staged exact wheels/model hashes and outbound network blocked, verify imports, deterministic classifications and at least three distinct intended picks; corrupt model must refuse before provider call.

groups.name: One operator's agent teams and six workflow topologies
groups.baseline_status: Six-value topology enum, dispatcher, workload admission and subagent orchestration source present. Fixture/test presence is not installed six-topology evidence.
tier_conditions: Included for SOLO; agent multiplicity does not imply TEAM_BINDING; workload/engine admissibility still applies
proposed_checks: Run six small local workflows under explicit solo config; check real child results, handoffs/iteration/parallel fan-in, inter-step outputs and bounded failure/cancel cleanup.

groups.name: MCP server/client integrations and tool discovery
groups.baseline_status: Actual FastMCP server registers run_workflow; real MCPClientHost starts transports, lists/calls tools and owns cleanup. Legacy mcp_host.py started=False placeholder does not describe the full later binding. Integration availability conditional on configured server and tool contracts.
tier_conditions: Solo can host run_workflow and consume configured external tools; stdio/streamable_http/SSE subject to trust/transport floors. HTTP MCP transport retained; separate HTTP operator recovery API excluded.
proposed_checks: Connect one admitted local MCP client to harness and invoke workflow; invoke one real external MCP tool, verify discovery/search, argument/result transit, trust refusal and shutdown cleanup.

groups.name: Local process, Docker and gVisor sandbox enforcement
groups.baseline_status: Configured T2/T3 drivers and timeout/cancel cleanup implemented. STDIO MCP floors to T3 even if template requests T1; runsc registration and local image required. T4 requests must refuse rather than silently downgrade if excluded substrate unavailable. Computer-use and code-execution force T4 in sandbox_tier_floor; the current factory provides E2B only at T4, so local/no-paid support for those capabilities is a concrete unresolved carrier gap, not a feature to silently omit.
tier_conditions: Solo still obeys delivered tier >= resolved floor. T1 host/T2 Docker/T3 runsc local; T4 current factory uses E2B managed full VM outside no-paid-local profile.
proposed_checks: Execute a harmless real tool in each selected T1/T2/T3 tier, inspect delivered runtime/network/image, trigger timeout/cancel and prove exact container/process cleanup; excluded T4 requirement returns typed refusal.

groups.name: Solo HITL policy and real safety decisions
groups.baseline_status: Per-persona/engine synchrony, named solo overrides and MCP elicitation/webhook integration source present. Solo scope does not waive actual rejected effects or external mutation safety boundaries.
tier_conditions: SOLO persona floor auto defaults true; local-mutation auto defaults false; other safety floors still compose. Per-step persona is a separate binding from deployment OD persona.
proposed_checks: One read-only action proceeds, one local mutation requires its configured decision, and one external-effect refusal/timeout remains refused; check resulting audit and no replay.

groups.name: Self-hosted telemetry, traces and cost visibility
groups.baseline_status: OTLP gRPC pipeline plus Compose Collector/Tempo/Grafana, loopback port bindings, Grafana file-secret and anonymous-off configuration exist. Solo sampling base rate1.0 source tested. Config is not proof of collector reachability, trace retention or Grafana login.
tier_conditions: SOLO local-development/self-hosted-server supported; team sampling/multi-tenant qualification deferred
proposed_checks: Emit one real local workflow with costs/tool events; retrieve its trace in local backend, verify redaction policy and missing-backend behavior; verify loopback exposure and authenticated Grafana access.

groups.name: Secret handling, local audit signatures and protected results
groups.baseline_status: Scoped allowlist secret resolution, plaintext-secret config rejection, local signature/key safety, audit verification and protected-result source exist. Solo redaction is operator-self-redact/toggleable, so content-capture safety needs explicit config. Local signer does not implement rotation by key period or defend against compromised OS user.
tier_conditions: Self-hosted-keyring/local optional keyring-env fallback; solo can select local Ed25519 and fail-closed signing; MTC forbids local signer and requires stronger tenant/delegated controls. Cloud KMS/GCP Secret Manager outside local profile.
proposed_checks: Resolve a nonsecret sentinel through keyring, deny an unlisted request, verify no secret/content leak; sign/read/tamper one local audit row and check failure policy plus protected-result retention/recovery when enabled.

groups.name: Local memory storage and persistence choices
groups.baseline_status: Stage5 registry and local backends implemented, with /memories path discipline, authenticated encrypted content and SQLite concurrency. Legacy roots are checkout-local unless verified state placement selected; installed durable storage remains gated.
tier_conditions: Automatic local memory default; filesystem/encrypted filesystem/operator-defined configurable, SQLite DATABASE for self-hosted-server; S3/managed DB/provider-native memory are explicit optional remote routes, not required local dependencies
proposed_checks: Create/read/change/retrieve one local memory through actual workflow, restart and retrieve again; verify traversal/tamper denial and correct instruction/profile provenance without accessing unrelated CLI memory.

groups.name: Retained state, pause/resume/recovery and backup boundary
groups.baseline_status: State-root verifier/stamp, durable journal and engine recovery, root claim/adopt/dispose primitives exist. Shipped profiles explicitly do not enable durable pause/resume; CLI/MCP operator exposure and actual recovery acceptance remain gated by B7/storage. No complete installed backup/reset/restore witness established; do not infer backup service from journal code.
tier_conditions: Solo safety/recovery remains in scope; durable opt-ins and actual retained root required. No multiuser/production soak prerequisite added.
proposed_checks: After actual root binding and released operator surface, perform a single end-to-end pause/process-death/restore/resume scenario; prove retained ledger/memory/claims, no duplicate external effect, refusal of stale/child/unauthorized resume, and bounded cleanup. Keep held until prerequisites accepted.
